logp.method_description: The LogP value for 1–4 was determined using the shake-flask method and UV/Vis spectroscopy. The octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with water. An aqueous solution (pH 6.99) of 1–4 (500 μL, 100 μm) was incubated with octanol (500 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 24 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the 1–4 content in each phase was determined by UV/Vis spectroscopy.
